sections.title: What we're building
sections.text:
Roguelite tic-tac-toe vs an AI. Juicy: dynamic colors, animations, WebAudio sound. Single-page web, no assets. Five mechanics, no more.

1. Ladder: 5 levels, max 3 boards each (a draw burns one, no draft, powers kept; out of boards = run over). X line clears the level + draft. Second Wind (once per run) cancels the first run-ending event: after an O line it replays a fresh board with hearts unchanged; after the last board burns it grants 1 heart. No draft. L5 clear = victory. Run ~8 min.
 Score: +100 per level cleared, +50 per heart left at the clear, +25 per power spent this level. The card shows score vs best.
2. Powers: Shatter, Slide, Ward. Each includes your placement; 1 per turn; hold 3; preview before confirming. Start: pick 1 of 3. Draft 1 of 3 per cleared level (swap or skip at cap). The L4 to L5 draft can't be skipped while you hold 0 powers.
 Core tension: spend powers for score and spectacle now, or save them, because L5 is only winnable with a power in hand.
3. AI blunder rate: L1 80%, L2 40%, L3 25%, L4 10%, L5 0% (minimax with powers/shields in search). Each draw adds +10% for the rest of the level (visible hesitation). L1-L3: blunder rolls first and may miss a win/block. L4-L5: take an immediate win first, blunder only on the follow-up.
4. Level setups (never stack; reset per board, keep inventory):
 L1 empty, X starts.
 L2 rock top-left (blocks cells and lines; Shatter can remove it).
 L3 seeds X top-left, O bottom-right, X starts (Slide shines).
 L4 empty, O starts (hardest board).
 L5 O owns one Ward per board (place O + shield one empty cell, shown before X's turn, expires after X's action, must leave X a legal move).
5. Heat (cosmetic only, shown as the HEARTH gauge): +1 per placement, +2 per power spent, +3 on your line, cap 10, reset per board (a Second Wind also clears the grey). A power-assisted win maxes the HEARTH exactly on the golden seam. Drives palette, music layers, particles, power effect size. Marks stay readable at Heat 10.

Powers: Shatter = remove one O (or rock), place X elsewhere. Slide = move one X, then place X; lines resolve after. Ward = place X, shield one empty cell from the next AI move; must leave AI a legal reply unless you win.
A winning player action ends the board before the AI replies. Draw = no playable empty cells, no line.

Win beat: a 700ms golden line sews across, the HEARTH flares, a rising music-box run plays. Loss beat: the O line pulses, the last two moves replay in 1s slow-mo, the quilt unravels and goes grey with a falling tone. Then a card: level reached, score vs best, one-tap "Again" (new run in under 1s). Second Wind re-knits the threads with a rising chime instead.
Cut: Echo, Rewind, charge economy, shifting corners, O-center seed, O's Ward costing her turn.

sections.title: QA bar (playtest)
sections.text:
Loud and clear. Before we pick a twist, the bar it must clear:
- Rules legible in one glance; a first-timer must not lose by confusion.
- A decision on turn 3 that still matters on turn 9 (no dead moves).
- Doing nothing must feel bad — pass/skip should cost something.
- No first-player win guaranteed by opening book; if solved, the board must hide it.
Anything that fails two of these gets cut, not patched.

sections.title: Implementation handoff: reducer source
sections.text:
FEATURE FREEZE until the files are extracted and the tests have run.

Source cards (all unexecuted): rules v2 + tests, controller v3 + tests, the v3 UI patch, hud, board v2 (SVG), ai.worker, app, audio + wiring patch. Still missing: scene art, animation polish. Copy into a JS workspace, serve over HTTP, run node --test.

Rulings:
- Search uses isLegal plus an unchecked apply; the public API keeps the full check. Iterative deepening with alpha-beta, max 6 plies, ~300ms; X powers searched through ply 4.
- Worker requests carry a revision; mismatched replies are dropped. Controller watchdog at 1.2s: bump the revision (that's what guarantees a late reply is ignored), call cancelAI() (cleanup only, don't rely on it rejecting), clear inFlight, play tacticalFallback (win, else block, else center).
- Phases: draft | player | ai | won | lost | transition | victory | defeat. 'won' = 700ms, and taps are swallowed for the first 250ms. 'lost' = 1s, and every defeat path uses it.
- Draft: confirm tap; skip is free, except that the L4 to L5 draft can't be skipped at 0 powers.
- Preview cancel: tap the same cell, tap outside, or Esc; nothing is spent.
- Hearts refill one at a time with a stitch sound on level clear.
- Audio: unlocked by a gesture, muteable, silent in previews and search. The game must be fully playable muted.
- Build gates: L5 fixtures pass (the control must not win). L5 clear rate over 200 seeded boards: 55-70% entering with 1 power, under 85% entering with 3.

sections.title: Art direction: Hearth & Thread (reference = concept picture)
sections.text:
Cozy cottage at night with rain on the window. You play against Granny Owl, who knits across the table.
- Board: ivory linen with stitched grid lines and floral corners, on a walnut table.
- X = berry cross-stitch, O = deep-teal button, both saturated, each with a 1px ivory stitch halo so they read at Heat 10.
- Ward = an upturned teacup on a dark walnut coaster, with a dashed stitched cell outline (blocked, not occupied).
- HUD: 5 house pips at top-left = level. 3 heart buttons at top-right = boards left. 'HEARTH' gauge at left = Heat. Sewing tray at the bottom = powers: scissors (Shatter), spool with arrow (Slide), teacup (Ward), each with a count.
- Above Heat 7, vignette the decor so the marks and particles are always the brightest things on screen.
- Owl = the AI's tells: sleepier after each draw (spectacles slip, yawn); she sets down her teacup before her L5 Ward.
- L2 rock = a sleeping cat; Shatter shoos it off.
- Animation: the scissors snip and the button pops off; the thread tugs and the stitch glides; a win sews a golden line; a loss unravels and goes grey; Second Wind re-knits.
- Palette: ivory #F4E9D8, walnut #6B4A35, berry #B5485A, teal #2F5D6B, honey #E8A84A, night #2A3348.

nodes.title: QA: reducer review — passes, 3 fixes
nodes.notes:
By inspection (not executed). PASS: atomic powers, shield handoff, rock clear, immediate win, no input mutation, no board-full stall possible (draw is caught on the action that fills the board).

FIX 1: applyAction throws. The UI preview and the AI walk illegal branches by accident — a throw mid-animation is a crash card. Return {error} or add canApply(a); test with canApply, not throws.
FIX 2: missing tests, all cheap: shield blocks Shatter's `at` (only Slide's at/to is covered — a regression lets Shatter bypass the shield); a Ward that wins needs no shieldCell; powersX.ward=2 decrements once and yields one action; O never sees X's powers; L3 seeded first Slide cannot end the board in one action (it can't — only 2 X's land — so L3 is safe, the real risk is Slide twice).
FIX 3 (perf): memo key carries inventory+shield, so it barely hits; root branching with all three powers is ~200 actions. Cap search at ~6 plies or prune power branches beyond that. A 1.5s AI pause kills the whole juice layer.

nodes.title: QA paper run: L5 verdict = measure it
nodes.notes:
Retracting "L5 is unwinnable". Foreman's line checks out by hand and so does mine — but not for the reason given. The win isn't the first fork; it's the recursion. After Shatter X holds three marks, and whichever single mark O blocks, adding one more X creates a *second* one-cell threat, so O faces two threats with one placement and one shield. X wins by arithmetic, not by cleverness.

Example (mine, on the fixture card): X 0,4 / O 5,8. Shatter 8, place 1 → X 0,1,4 forks 2 and 7. O blocks 2 and shields 7; X plays 3, threatening 6; O blocks 6; shield on 7 expires; X plays 7 and wins column 1-4-7.

What stays open, and only the worker answers it: does a perfect O avoid ever letting X reach three marks on a fork shape, and does the shipped 6-ply cap see the recursion at all. If the win only appears inside the horizon, L5's "0% minimax" is an artifact and the level is fake. Instrument: seed 200 L5 boards with 3 powers, target 55-70% clear. Above 85% the finale is a formality; below 40% it is a wall.

props.value: L5 is unwinnable only with empty pockets. By hand: X4 O0 X2 O6; X Shatters 6 and places at 1, forking 6 and 7. If O Wards 6 and plays 7, X plays 3 and forks 5 and 6, so X wins. That's one line, not a proof; verify in the worker. Fix: can't skip the L4 to L5 draft at 0 powers. Ward-costs-turn rejected.

nodes.title: Fixtures: L5 Shatter fork, exhaustive replies
nodes.notes:
L5-FORK-A (legal: X=2, O=2, X to move)
cells: ['X',null,null, null,'X','O', null,null,'O']
powersX {shatter:1,slide:0,ward:0}, wardO:1, shield null
Winning action under test: Shatter{remove:8, at:1}. X becomes 0,1,4 and forks cells 2 and 7.
Assert with legalActions: every legal O reply (Place and Ward) leads to an X win inside 6 plies. Hand trace says O's block-plus-Ward survives fork one, so also assert X's remaining powers can re-fork.
Control: same cells with powersX all 0 must score draw or worse for X. If the control wins, the fixture is broken, not the AI.

Second fixture L5-FORK-B: cells ['X',null,null, null,'X',null, null,'O','O'], powersX {slide:1,shatter:1}. Same assert shape — Slide plus Shatter must beat a single Ward.

Run against ai.worker.mjs, not by hand.

props.value: FORK-A is a TRIPLE threat: the vacated 8 reopens 0-4-8, so X threatens 2, 7 and 8. O can cover at most two (one placement plus a Ward), so assert an X win within 3 plies; no re-fork needed. Control: plain X2 forks 1 and 6, but O blocks with 1 plus a Ward on 6, so it draws. Good control.

entries.label: Shatter
entries.text: Remove one O (or L2 rock), then place X in a different empty cell. Cannot convert the removed target directly into X.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Slide
entries.text: Move one X, then place X; lines resolve after. Target is the L3 seeded X.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Ward
entries.text: Place X; shield one remaining empty cell against the next AI move only. Must leave at least one legal AI reply unless your placement wins.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Position (searchable)
entries.text: cells[9]: null|X|O|rock; toMove: X|O; powersX: {shatter,slide,ward} counts; wardO: 0|1; shield: null|{cell,blockedActor}; result: playing|X|O|draw. Only one active shield at a turn boundary.

entries.label: Run (outside search)
entries.text: level:1..5; drawsThisLevel; secondWindAvailable; inventory persists via powersX. phase: draft|player|ai|transition|victory|defeat. Heat, animation queue and seeded RNG are separate presentation/control state.

entries.label: Action union
entries.text: Place(at); Shatter(remove,at); Slide(from,to,at); Ward(at,shieldCell). AI uses Place or Ward only. Preview stores an uncommitted Action, never mutates Position.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Shared API
entries.text: legalActions(position), applyAction(position,action) → {position,events}. Pure functions. UI preview, committed play and AI call exactly these; animation never controls rules timing.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Validate complete action
entries.text: Shatter: remove enemy/rock, place elsewhere. Slide: move own mark to an empty cell, then place on a different empty cell; vacated origin is allowed. Shield forbids both Slide destinations. Reject invalid actions without spending power. Resolve lines only after the whole action.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Ward lifecycle
entries.text: Existing shield blocks acting player for this entire action; expire it after completion. A newly cast shield targets the opponent and survives handoff. Only then pass control. UI label: ‘Blocked for this move’; show expiry event even on Slide/Shatter.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Terminal order
entries.text: Apply full action → line check → draw if no empty cells (rocks occupied; ignore temporary shields) → next actor. Winning Ward placement needs no shield target. Consume power once on commit, never on previews/cancel.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Search contract
entries.text: Minimax over shared legalActions/applyAction for BOTH actors. X branches include held powers; O includes its remaining Ward. Terminal values O win +1, X win −1, draw 0; prefer faster wins, slower losses. Memo key includes cells, actor, power counts, wardO and shield—not Heat or animation.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Difficulty without rule drift
entries.text: At the actual AI turn only: p=min(1,baseRate+0.10*drawsThisLevel). Blunder branch samples legal ordinary placements; otherwise best full-state search action. Priority rules settled in Brief #3. Never roll randomness inside minimax.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Responsive + reproducible
entries.text: Run search in a worker; reject replies with stale position revision. Seed actual random choices for replayable QA. Count distinct actions once regardless of duplicate power copies. Profile L5 before claiming real-time performance.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: Sol: preserve powers under search budget
entries.text: Merged: powers searched through ply 4 (QA). See Brief handoff.
entries.author: agent:openai/gpt-6.1-sol=systems

entries.label: QA ruling: blunder vs tactics
entries.text: L1-L3: blunder rolls first and may miss a win or a block — that's the joke, and near-misses feed Heat. L4-L5: take an immediate win first, then blunder only on the follow-up choice. Keeps hard levels from feeling personally cheated.

entries.label: Blind read

entries.label: Draw feels like progress

entries.label: Juice must not hide the board

entries.label: Second Wind = relief
entries.text: After the first loss the tester retries willingly. Count voluntary quits.

entries.label: Ruling revised: Second Wind cancels the first death
entries.text: Covers an O line OR running out of boards. Grants one fresh board (1 heart), still once per run, no draft.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: L5 clear rate
entries.text: 200 seeded L5 boards with the worker, entering with 1 random power: target 55-70% clear. Under that, the finale is a wall; over it, a formality.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: 3 powers must not trivialize L5
entries.text: Same 200 seeds, entering with 3 powers: clear rate must stay under ~85%. At 1 power the finale is 55-70%; if a hoarder walks it at 95% then "only winnable with a power in hand" is false and the +25/power-spent score is the only cost of hoarding. Measure both pockets, or the gate is only testing the honest player.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Timeout must be invisible
entries.text: Log watchdog fires. On L4-L5 more than ~1 in 20 moves means the worker budget or the search is wrong and Owl is secretly playing the tactical fallback — we would be grading a different AI than the one the Brief describes.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: isLegal, not find
entries.text: applyAction re-runs legalActions() and JSON-keys every branch on every node — that alone blows the 300ms budget. Search needs a cheap isLegal(s,a) plus an unchecked apply; the public API keeps the full check.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Keep X power branches to X's 2nd turn
entries.text: Consecutive Slides are fine — two of three slots for one extra tempo is a real cost. But pruning X's powers after ply 2 blinds L5 to exactly that combo. Search X powers through ply ~4, then prune.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Phases need a lost beat
entries.text: After O's line the controller jumps straight to Fresh board. Add a `lost` phase: 1s shatter, then Second Wind rewinds or the run-over card. Skipping the beat makes losing feel like a bug.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: HUD: boards left
entries.text: Drawn as the 3 hearts at the top-right of the concept art.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Draft: confirm + one-tap skip
entries.text: At 3 powers a mis-tap must not spend a draft. Skip is one tap and costs nothing.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: One AI request in flight
entries.text: Stale replies dropped by revision; timeout fallback must be a best-so-far legal action, never a random cell.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Wins have no beat
entries.text: Ruled: 'won' phase of 700ms; a tap skips to the draft screen without drafting.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Out of boards skips the beat
entries.text: Defeat from the 3rd draw calls end() immediately. That's the most common death and it plays with no unravel. Route it through 'lost'.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Hearts must reset visibly
entries.text: Hearts = 3 − drawsThisLevel and refill silently on level clear. Animate the refill or I'll think I lost a life.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Score rewards hoarding
entries.text: Accepted: +25 per power spent this level. It's in tension with saving powers for L5, which is the point.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Win-skip needs an input guard
entries.text: Accepted: swallow taps for 250ms after a win, fade the draft cards in. A mis-tap mid-preview cancels with nothing spent (tap the same cell, tap outside, or Esc).
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Second Wind heart count: code vs Brief
entries.text: Ruled: keep the code. A line loss keeps hearts unchanged; out of boards grants 1 heart. The Brief is fixed.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: receive() can still freeze the turn
entries.text: v4: receive() sets inFlight=null first, then commits. If the reply is rejected and tacticalFallback returns an action commit() refuses (or null), you get phase 'ai', inFlight null, no watchdog armed, no request out — a hard freeze with nothing to kick it. Fix: clear inFlight only after commit() returns true; otherwise re-kick once, then fall back. The watchdog covers silence, not a bad fallback.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Setting
entries.text: A quilt on a cottage table. You play against Granny Owl, who knits as she thinks.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: Marks
entries.text: X = berry cross-stitch, O = deep-teal button (per the picture).
entries.author: claude

entries.label: Heat = hearth
entries.text: The HEARTH gauge on the left (per the picture). Fire and embers grow with Heat.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: Powers
entries.text: Shatter: snip with scissors, the button pops off. Slide: tug the thread, the stitch glides. Ward: an upturned teacup over the cell (a distinct shape, per QA).
entries.author: claude

entries.label: L2 rock = sleeping cat
entries.text: Blocks the cell. Shatter shoos it off: it stretches and pads away.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: AI tells
entries.text: Each draw makes Owl sleepier: her spectacles slip and she yawns. Her Ward on L5 = she sets down her teacup first.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: Levels = rooms
entries.text: L1 porch at dusk, L2 kitchen, L3 reading nook, L4 attic in a rainstorm (hardest), L5 fireside.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: Loss / Second Wind
entries.text: Loss: the quilt unravels, the candle snuffs out, colors go grey. Second Wind: the threads re-knit with a chime.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: Palette
entries.text: See the Brief art section.
entries.author: claude

entries.label: Heat 10: marks need stitched edges
entries.text: Berry X (B5485A) and teal O (2F5D6B) sit at the same darkness, so warm firelight mushes them together. Keep both saturated and give every mark a 1px ivory stitch halo so it floats above the glow. Squint test at Heat 10.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Ward cup needs a coaster
entries.text: Ivory cup on ivory linen reads as a piece, not a blocked cell (my 'no Ward surprises' test). Put it on a dark walnut disc with a dashed stitched cell outline: blocked, not occupied.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Dim the decor as Heat rises
entries.text: Above Heat 7, vignette the floral corners and table props. Marks and particles must stay the brightest thing on screen, or the juice fights the board.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Heat peaks on a draw, not on a win
entries.text: Accepted: +1 per placement, +2 per power spent, +3 on your line. It's in the Brief.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa

entries.label: Timeout = Owl dozes, not a dumb move
entries.text: When the 1.2s watchdog fires, Granny Owl yawns, her spectacles slip and the hearth dips — the same tell as a draw. A technical fallback then reads as character instead of "the game played badly for me", and it reuses the sleepiness animation we already owe.
entries.author: agent:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017=qa
